server_arguments.name: max_input_bytes
server_arguments.label: max-input-bytes
server_arguments.desc: Per-request input size limit in bytes (default 2 GB). Submissions larger than this are rejected with HTTP 413 before they hit the queue.

server_arguments.name: max_input_duration_seconds
server_arguments.label: max-input-duration-seconds
server_arguments.desc: Maximum allowed input video duration, in seconds (default 30 minutes). Validated by ffprobe at submit time.

server_arguments.name: max_input_resolution
server_arguments.label: max-input-resolution
server_arguments.desc: Maximum allowed input resolution as 'WxH' (e.g. '1920x1080', '2048x2048'). Validated by ffprobe; inputs above this cap are rejected with HTTP 400.

server_arguments.name: allowed_video_extensions
server_arguments.label: allowed-video-extensions
server_arguments.desc: Comma-separated whitelist of accepted file extensions (must include the leading dot). Anything else returns HTTP 415 fast, before content probing.

server_arguments.name: allowed_video_codecs
server_arguments.label: allowed-video-codecs
server_arguments.desc: Comma-separated whitelist of accepted video codec names as reported by ffprobe's codec_name field. Anything else is rejected with HTTP 400 + unsupported_codec.

server_arguments.name: output_codec
server_arguments.label: output-codec
server_arguments.desc: Output video codec passed to ffmpeg as -c:v. Pinning the output to one codec keeps caller-side decoding predictable.

server_arguments.name: output_container
server_arguments.label: output-container
server_arguments.desc: Output container format. Combined with output-codec to produce a single deterministic output type per deployment.

server_arguments.name: queue_capacity
server_arguments.label: queue-capacity
server_arguments.desc: **IMPORTANT** primary backpressure control. Maximum number of submitted-but-not-yet-completed jobs the in-process queue holds. Beyond this, POST /jobs returns 503 Retry-After. Higher values absorb more burst load but use more memory and scratch disk per job.

server_arguments.name: max_work_dir_bytes
server_arguments.label: max-work-dir-bytes
server_arguments.desc: Local writeable scratch directory size limit in bytes (default 100 GB). When usage approaches this cap, POST /jobs returns 503 even if the queue is not full — protects the node from runaway disk use.

server_arguments.name: job_retention_seconds
server_arguments.label: job-retention-seconds
server_arguments.desc: How long terminal jobs (succeeded / failed / canceled) and their output files are kept after completion before the TTL sweeper deletes them.

server_arguments.name: gpu_memory_fraction
server_arguments.label: gpu-memory-fraction
server_arguments.desc: Fraction of total VRAM that PyTorch is allowed to allocate (passed to torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction). Leaving headroom prevents kernel-level OOM kills; PyTorch raises a clean OutOfMemoryError at the cap instead.

server_arguments.name: chunk_frames
server_arguments.label: chunk-frames
server_arguments.desc: Temporal chunk size — number of frames the model processes per pass. Long videos are split into windows of this size (with overlap-frames overlap), processed sequentially, and stitched.

server_arguments.name: overlap_frames
server_arguments.label: overlap-frames
server_arguments.desc: Number of overlapping frames between consecutive temporal chunks, used for smooth stitching of the restored output.

server_arguments.name: min_chunk_frames
server_arguments.label: min-chunk-frames
server_arguments.desc: Floor for the adaptive shrinking inside the per-chunk OOM trap. If a chunk OOMs we retry once at half size; this is the minimum size we'll go down to before failing the job with insufficient_vram.

server_arguments.name: vae_tile_size
server_arguments.label: vae-tile-size
server_arguments.desc: VAE decode tile size in pixels. Tiling the VAE decoder bounds peak VRAM at high output resolutions, where the decoder is otherwise the largest single allocation.

server_arguments.name: inference_dtype
server_arguments.label: inference-dtype
server_arguments.desc: Numeric type for inference. fp16 is the trained dtype and is fastest on H200; bf16 is more numerically forgiving but slightly slower.

server_arguments.name: worker_heartbeat_seconds
server_arguments.label: worker-heartbeat-seconds
server_arguments.desc: How often the GPU worker subprocess emits a heartbeat to the supervisor.

server_arguments.name: worker_heartbeat_timeout
server_arguments.label: worker-heartbeat-timeout
server_arguments.desc: Supervisor restarts the worker if no heartbeat is received within this many seconds. Should be greater than worker-heartbeat-seconds plus the slowest expected chunk time on healthy hardware.

server_arguments.name: shutdown_grace_seconds
server_arguments.label: shutdown-grace-seconds
server_arguments.desc: On SIGTERM, the server stops accepting new requests and waits up to this many seconds for the in-flight job to finish before failing it with code=shutdown. Set Kubernetes terminationGracePeriodSeconds >= this + 10.

server_arguments.name: log_level
server_arguments.label: log-level
server_arguments.desc: Python logging level for the structured JSON logs.
